shortDescription: Robinhood Markets NASDAQ:HOOD was trading lower as third-quarter earnings missed analyst expectations on unrealized losses related to its venture capital fund, Robinhood Ventures Fund I NYSE:RVI.Shares were down 4.77% to $90.05 during post-market trading on Tuesday.Adjusted EPS fell to $0.60 in Q3…

children: missed analyst expectations on unrealized losses related to its venture capital fund, Robinhood Ventures Fund I
Shares were down 4.77% to $90.05 during post-market trading on Tuesday.
Adjusted EPS fell to $0.60 in Q3 from $0.62 in the same period a year ago, but increased from the second quarter's $0.50.

Diluted earnings per share decreased 16% to $0.51, trailing the Visible Alpha consensus of $0.55. The metric included unrealized losses primarily related to the mark-to-market of Robinhood Ventures Fund I.
Total net revenue increased 12% from the prior year to $1.42B, slightly below the Visible Alpha consensus of $1.43B.
Transaction-based revenue rose 19% to $867M, vs. the $868.09M consensus. Net interest revenue fell 9% to $415M, vs. $423.32M consensus.
The increase in transaction-based revenue was primarily driven by event contracts revenue of $173M, up over 6x; options revenue of $399M, up 31%; and equities revenue of $121M, up 41%.
Meanwhile, cryptocurrency revenue was down 55% to $120M.
Net interest revenue decrease was primarily driven by lower securities lending activity and short-term interest rates.

"We also added a new business cylinder with over $100M in annualized revenues this quarter as Rothera scaled rapidly. And we're entering Q4 with strong momentum, as October net deposits have already topped $13B month-to-date, including $6B from the Dell family's contribution to Trump Accounts," said CFO Shiv Verma.

The financial services provider lowered the top end of its 2026 adjusted operating expenses outlook and SBC by $25M to a range of $2.675B to $2.750B. The guidance change resulted from ongoing efficiency gains across the business.
Earnings call is scheduled for 5 PM ET today.

title: Robinhood stock dips as venture capital fund-related losses hit Q3 EPS
